description: This file defines the FilterFormatListBuilder class in Drupal, responsible for building and managing the admin listing interface for filter format entities, including rendering headers, rows, operations, and handling form submissions.

classes.name: FilterFormatListBuilder
classes.description: A class extending DraggableListBuilder to create an admin interface for listing and managing filter format entities in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the list builder.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the form ID for the filter admin overview.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the list table.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a data row for each filter format entity, including handling fallback formats and roles.

methods.name: getDefaultOperations
methods.description: Defines default operations (edit, disable) for each entity, with special handling for fallback formats and disabled formats.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for the list, customizing the submit button label.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, resets filter formats, and displays a status message.
